subqueries.label: primary
subqueries.search_query: business coach worth it small business owner
subqueries.ranking_query: Firsthand accounts from small business owners deciding whether a business coach, mastermind or group coaching program was worth the money, or why they quit or never hired one. Prefer owners with an operating business and customers. Exclude coaches promoting their own services.

subqueries.label: mastermind
subqueries.search_query: mastermind group worth it business owner
subqueries.ranking_query: Business owners describing what happened in a paid mastermind or peer group, good or bad. Exclude sales pitches for masterminds.

subqueries.label: too-busy
subqueries.search_query: overwhelmed small business owner doing everything myself
subqueries.ranking_query: Owners of established small businesses saying they are maxed out, doing everything themselves, stuck, and cannot take on more, including about getting help. Exclude vendor marketing.
